digest.component_or_area: MCP tool response models and handlers
propositions: MCP clients cannot see CLI stderr, so cross-session warnings must be carried in the structured tool response of single-ticket MCP tools
Add optional `cross_session_warning: str | None` field to `WriteAckOut` and `TicketStateOut` models for single-ticket read/write handlers to expose session conflict advisories
The warning must be computed before the underlying mutation runs to reflect ticket state at operation time, not post-mutation
Single-ticket write handlers (comment, edit, tag, archive, link, etc.) and show_ticket read handler populate the warning via the shared `_ack` helper
transition_ticket and reopen_ticket add `cross_session_warning` as an additive dict key in their raw engine result return, present only when non-None and back-compatible
Bulk read tools (list_tickets, ready_tickets, search, next_batch) and claim_ticket are excluded from populating the field
